_comment: EEGNet baseline settings for train_baseline.py, from EEG-FM-Compass (github.com/Dingkun0817/EEG-FM-Benchmark). 'loso' = their README 'LOSO for DL baselines (EEGNet on BNCI2014001)' command plus argparse defaults; 'fewshot' = their config/BNCI2014004.json EEGNet.full with the booleans as that json records them (their published reproduce_command strings turn every '--flag False' on, argparse type=bool). 'cells' overrides per dataset: 'published' = Compass's own setting for that dataset, 'ours' = chosen by us because Compass publishes no EEGNet setting for it. Checked 2026-10-06: all MI cells and the P300 / SSVEP loso cells within 1.7 points of Compass (docs/reports/2026-10-06-eegnet-compass-check.md).

loso._source: published (their BNCI2014004 config: no CAR, 4 s)
